Isolated asset concept sheet on a plain flat light grey studio background (the whole background is one uniform grey, no scene, no landscape, no sky, no UI). Concept sheet of separate stylized 3D game props for a cozy fantasy village, in a hand-painted, soft, warm painterly style with a gentle golden-afternoon palette (ivory, honey gold, sage green, warm terracotta, soft lavender-grey stone) (modern anime-inspired 3D RPG, clean chunky shapes). Arrange them in a clean grid of two rows with wide empty space between all objects, each one complete and fully visible, never overlapping, never cropped:
row 1: a round stone village well with a small wooden roof and a bucket on a rope; a short section of rustic wooden fence (three posts, two rails); a small market stall with wooden counter and a striped cream and dusty-red cloth awning, a few crates of apples on the counter; a wooden hand cart with two large wheels loaded with hay.
row 2: a wooden lantern post with an iron hanging lantern; a small cluster of two wooden barrels and two wooden crates; an arched old stone footbridge with low parapets (seen from the side at three-quarter angle).
Each object seen from a three-quarter front view, camera slightly above (about 30 degrees). Plain flat light grey background, no ground, no cast shadows, no scenery. Even soft lighting with almost no shading, flat hand-painted colors and soft painted textures, no black ink outlines, no text, no labels.
